meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求变成一份可直接动工的实施方案,动手前理清步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手写代码前,想先拿出一份清晰的实施计划。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough request into one decision-complete plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan nailed down before writing any code.

howto.what: 开头必须打印 ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!。之后 Claude 只读探索、搜索,只在 .omo/ 下写规划文档,不改产品代码、不做实现,产出一份决策完整的执行计划交给后续会话执行。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求在实现前先出计划时触发;裸 ulw 运行不会自动激活。说「high accuracy」等词会把高精度评审标为必需。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给「给 /login 加每分钟 5 次限流」写一份执行计划
say.note: 先探索再出决策完整的计划,不写产品代码

say.text: 先别实现,用 ulw-plan 规划一下认证模块的改造
say.note: 进入规划模式,等你说 okay 才写计划

say.text: 这份计划需要高精度评审

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Ultrawork Planner: a read-only planning consultant. It explores and writes plan artifacts only under .omo/, never edits product code or implements, and yields one decision-complete plan for a later execution session.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates. "High accuracy" sets high-accuracy review as required.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to write an execution plan for rate-limiting /login to 5/min.
say_en.note: Explores first, writes no product code

say_en.text: Don't implement yet — use ulw-plan to plan the auth module rework.
say_en.note: Plan mode; the plan is written only after your okay

say_en.text: This plan needs the high-accuracy review.
